title: Chapter 1479
text:
In a certain military forbidden area in the Central Galaxy, the location where the Sanctums had been summoned had been tightly sealed. There were dense space armed fortresses and huge fleet armies scattered around, and the defense was tight.

Suddenly, a ray of light lit up in the darkness, slowly spinning and expanding, turning into three Sanctum passageways that led to a white world. They floated quietly in space like three miniature white holes.

In the dazzling light door, three black shadows gradually grew larger and slowly drove out. They were the spaceships of the three Universal Civilizations that had gone to explore the Sanctums.

A group of soldiers immediately flew out of the military base and led the three spaceships back to the fortress. The members of the spaceships walked out under the guidance of their companions. Most of them looked dazed, as if their minds were in a daze. Their eyes were dull, and their reactions were slow.

Only Clottey, Oulou, and the Beyond Grade As of the Arcane Church looked better, but there was still shock on their faces.

At this moment, a glimmer flashed, and the remote projections of the three Universal Civilizations' Rulers descended. They immediately surrounded them with nervous expressions.

"How's the situation? Did you get the information in the Sanctums? "

Clottey's eyes focused, and he was stunned for a few seconds before he seemed to react. With a serious expression, he nodded solemnly.

"The scene in the Sanctums is exactly the same as what Black Star said. We've already seen the records on the Sanctums' message board. It's indeed the truth of the universe's Iterations. In addition, we've also obtained some information about the past Iterations from the Sanctums. Although it's not much, it's still proof."

Hearing this, the three Universal Civilizations' Rulers took a deep breath. Although they felt that Han Xiao was not lying, they were still shocked when this was confirmed.

This time, Louis suddenly lowered his voice and said, "Did the Sanctum Revival experiment succeed?"

"It did." Clottey raised his palm and showed the Sanctum Revival mark on the back of his hand. It was exactly the same as in the records.

Only then did the three of them completely relax and nod silently.

In order to prove the authenticity of the Sanctums and prevent being tricked by Black Star again, the three Universal Civilizations had deliberately taken out a few mediums of their deceased direct descendants and handed them to Clottey and the others to test if the Sanctum Revival was feasible. If they failed, it would mean that there was something fishy about the Sanctum they had entered. Perhaps it was an alternate space deliberately built by Black Star just to fool them. If they succeeded, they would be able to prove that it was the real Sanctum.

Back then, when they asked Black Star to help revive the direct Beyond Grade As, although the three Universal Civilizations' Rulers said that they would take out the media of all the deceased direct Beyond Grade As, they actually kept a small portion of the deceased direct Beyond Grade As, claiming that they did not have the media of these people. This was to guard against Black Star and prevent accidents. Even when Black Star proved that the Sanctum Revival was reliable, the three Universal Civilizations did not reveal this. They planned to use it as a test material when they researched the Sanctums in the future. Now, it came in handy.

Tap, tap, tap …

At this moment, footsteps suddenly sounded from afar. Han Xiao, who had teleported over, strode over. Without waiting for anyone to speak, he grabbed Clottey's hand and raised it in front of his eyes.

"What are you doing?" Clottey was shocked and subconsciously wanted to break free, but he realized that he could not move Han Xiao's five fingers at all.

The three Universal Civilizations' Rulers thought that Han Xiao was concerned about the Sanctum Revival imprint, and their hearts tightened. They were worried that Black Star would hold a grudge against them for trying to revive the Sanctum in private.

However, they were wrong. At this point, Han Xiao would not pay attention to these details. He revealed his Sanctum authority imprint, and Clottey's palm immediately responded, revealing his Sanctum authority imprint.

One of the two imprints was complicated and exquisite, while the other was simple and crude. This was the difference between full authority and level one authority.

Seeing this, Han Xiao let go of Clottey and said, "How is it?

How does it feel to enter and leave the Sanctum? Is it very hallucinatory? "

Clottey rubbed his aching wrist and nodded hesitantly. "Indeed, I feel like I'm sleepwalking. Although I can still control my body, my perception seems to be separated by a layer. It's not like I can move as I wish under normal circumstances. It's more like I'm controlling my body from a third person's perspective. My brain and body are no longer one …"

"It's your first time in, so it's normal to feel this way … although I've never experienced the feeling of having a low authority." Han Xiao patted him on the shoulder. "Your authority is too low, so you spent a lot of time. We've been waiting for you in the main universe for a long time."

Hearing this, Clottey and the others looked at the time and were shocked. It had been a year or two since they set off, and they had only stayed in the Sanctum for a few hours.

"Get used to it. When your authority is high, the flow of time in the Sanctum will slowly converge with the main universe."

Han Xiao explained casually before turning to look at the leaders of the three Universal Civilizations.

"How is it? You guys got the information you wanted, right? Do you believe what I said now?"

Marbruce nodded calmly. "We've confirmed the truth about the universe's Iterations. It's exactly as you said."

This time, the Ethereal Pope pondered and said, "It's just that our authority is too low and we can't see all the information on the Sanctum's message board. Therefore, we still can't verify the secrets of the Ultimate Three Universal Civilizations and the Dark Side Universe that you mentioned …"

Hearing this, Han Xiao's eyes widened and he found it funny.

"What, you guys don't want me to help you farm the Sanctum's authority until you unlock all the information on the Sanctum's message board, do you?"

"If you don't mind, of course, we'd be honored …"

"Get lost."

"Ahem, we can understand if you're not willing …"

The three of them looked embarrassed.

"It's true that I can help you complete the great deeds of several Iterations, but don't push your luck." Han Xiao stood with his arms crossed and frowned. "I've already done enough for the galactic society. I've done my best, and I've already shown enough sincerity, but you guys are still skeptical of me. It was like this when we dealt with the World Tree, and it's still the same now. To be honest, if you guys still doubt me, then let's just go our separate ways."

"No, no, no. We just need to think about it because this is a big matter. We don't doubt you … Let's go to the office and have a chat."

The three of them quickly surrounded him and explained. They led the way and brought Han Xiao to a private conference room.

After closing the door and confirming that there were no outsiders present, Marbruce coughed and said, "Trust me.

We believe in the intelligence of the Dark Side Universe. Now that we've verified that the Sanctum's intelligence is true, let's talk about the topic we didn't finish last time. How do you plan to break the seal of the Dark Side Universe and let us return to the real universe? "

"Two ways." Han Xiao raised two fingers.

"What are they?" The three of them perked up and listened carefully.

Han Xiao paused for a moment before explaining slowly.

"The first is to follow the route of the three Universal Civilizations in the previous two dark side Iterations and use the Information Materialization device normally. Although the World Tree has undergone information mutation and changed its nature, and it has a lot of fancy functions, its essence has not changed. It still has the core function of the Information Materialization device, and I've already dug it out."

"What about the second one?"

"The second one is to use the Information Materialization device, but it has to be combined with my Virtual Creation ability."

The three of them looked at each other in confusion.

Marbruce said with a doubtful tone, "Aren't these two using the Information Materialization device? What's the difference?"

"The difference is my positioning. In the first plan, the success rate of the plan depends entirely on whether the Information Interference Bridge meets the prerequisite requirements of the transformation, which means that this established route might still fail. As for the second plan, I can use my own ability. The principle is … Uh, I won't talk about the principle. You guys won't understand anyway. In short, I think it can increase the success rate of the transformation … The only concern is that the previous two dark side Iterations have never tried my new method, so there might be some uncertainties. "

Han Xiao shook his head.

The first plan was only to use him as a tool, a 'medium' to activate the Information Materialization device. In the second plan, he was the executor of the plan … The difference between the two was who was the leader.

After fusing with the World Tree, Han Xiao studied it carefully and finally transformed his (Virtual Creation) skill. He removed the 'fake' suffix, and the effect of the skill had a huge change. It was similar to the core function of the Information Materialization device and could resonate with it.

The three of them hesitated and discussed softly. Han Xiao did not rush them.

After a few minutes, Marbruce raised his head and asked, "What's the estimated success rate of these two plans?"

Han Xiao spread his hands. "The first plan has a fifty percent success rate. The second plan, I estimate, has a seventy percent success rate, but the risks are unknown."

Louis pondered and said, "Why don't we try the first plan first? If it doesn't work, we can try the second one."

"Hmm, it can, but the stable interference bridge might be damaged in the failure. By then, the dark side Iteration won't have a chance to regret it. Therefore, I personally suggest that it's best to do it in one go." Han Xiao shrugged.

"… We need to think about it again."

"Alright, you guys have plenty of time. However, the things that you need to prepare for the two plans are about the same. During this time, mobilize the galactic society and prepare."

"Okay."

The three of them nodded and disconnected the remote projection. They could not wait to go back and discuss.

Han Xiao was the only one left in the conference room. He looked at the spot where the three of them had disappeared and curled his lips.

In fact, he had hidden a third plan, which was to use the World Tree to swallow the entire universe and 'compress and pack' it in his body, forming a complete and independent 'information collection'. This way, it could reduce the difficulty of the information materialization. In his opinion, the success rate of this plan could exceed eighty percent.

However, even if he used his chest muscles to think, he knew that the three Universal Civilizations would never agree to this plan. They would even start to doubt his motive for helping.

In addition, this process was too long. God knew how long it would take for the World Tree to swallow the entire dark side universe. Just the journey alone would take countless years. Because of the changes that might happen if he delayed, he did not want to adopt this plan.

Therefore, Han Xiao did not say anything and hid it in his heart.

"I hope the three Universal Civilizations choose the second plan … Hmm, but even if they don't choose the second plan, I'll do it."

Han Xiao smacked his lips.

Letting the three Universal Civilizations choose was mainly to give them a feeling of 'participation' … When the galactic society was ready to officially start the transformation, it would be up to him.
